title: Android widget shows delta from last data point, instead of delta calculated from trend shown in notification/app
body:
When there is missing data, the widget shows a delta from the last data point (e.x., 168mg/dl at 10:47PM, 179mg/dl at 11:02PM = +11 delta) instead of calculating it algorithmically, I presume, as is done in the notification and on the main screen of the xDrip app. Ideally the widget should be consistent with the rest of the application.

![screenshot_20180213-230524](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/192620/36187424-3ffa5ee0-1113-11e8-9102-fe42b0a10322.png)
